Batch 5 independent E2/E3/E4 checks

1,507 successful scoped assertions across 13 families from Paper1D-Batch5IndependentControls-v1_1.py and its machine-readable result. Family-level provenance distinguishes exact symbolic evidence from bounded examples and E2 corroboration; see JSON. Fresh source checks include:

  • Weighted reciprocal involution and Euler anticommutation; exact conjugate pairs and quotient-type reductions under their stated regularity/domain.
  • Schur-complement Gaussian return kernel and Dirichlet-to-Neumann matrix relations, with positivity/linear-invertibility guards retained.

  • Pauli–Dirac polynomial matrix controls for Fischer kernel dimensions at degrees 1–4, not an all-degree global spectral certificate.
  • Additional reciprocal contact, convexity, zeta-formal and parity checks; numerical examples cannot prove a continuous-domain statement.

Archived executables: 4 independently rerun and passed: HadronScaleTest-v1_10, PetersenBridges-v1_3, ReciprocalSignedCoupling-v1_1, and ThreeCycleReconstruction-v1_2. F40MirrorGluing-v1_1 did not replay because required PetersenHodgePlucker-v1_10 is absent from the archive; record it as a missing evidence dependency, not a mathematical contradiction. Final source-specific interpretation

The IC19 natural determinant theorem asserts (h_t,w_t,r_J,ζ_nat)=(1,1,0,0) subject to its written G20/G21 and RT.53.4/NY–NZ/OB–OL geometric premises. The independent finite parity, lens and determinant counts support only their scoped steps. An enumeration of four extending boundary configurations from fourteen possibilities does not determine the named h_t and w_t bits. No physical decay occurrence is concluded.

Bounded object and coverage ledger

The 26,295-line manuscript was audited in six contiguous batches, totaling 272/272 formal statement dispositions, including definitions, conditional theorems and relevant formal remarks.
